data.name: Dayamayee
data.gender_notes: Dayamayee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dayamayee is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Daya' (compassion) and 'Mayee' (Mother). This name is dedicated to the compassionate goddess who nurtures and protects her children. It is a tribute to the unending love and kindness of a mother. The name Dayamayee carries the meaning “Compassionate Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayamayee usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies compassion and maternal love.
data.etymology: Dayamayee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayamayee total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
